description: Integrity. Resilience. Strength. Compassion. Focus. These traits define my life and drives my success as your representative, like delivering over $20 million in state resources directly to District 11. I’m focused on the long-term solutions we need to support businesses, build more housing, expedite services that help people off the streets and into permanent housing, address public safety, and improve the quality of life for us all. Let's build a California for everyone!
